propagation: actual full contextual factual sentences; never mechanically extract a bare entity or scalar
rewrite_inputs: current self-contained question, original query, previous questions and complete candidate answer sentences; no gold answers or support annotations
rewrite_output: one self-contained retrieval question, or the exact original question if no safe useful rewrite exists
rewrite_gate: previous complete candidate answers are optional context; explicit missing information must not become a guessed binding
final_input: unchanged original Top10 plus generated auxiliary questions and complete answers, same frozen placement and final reader
comparison: historical S02 is a descriptive reference; matched ideal-plan control required to isolate dual retrieval if selected
best_baseline_reference: historical references are reported offline and never enter generation inputs
